name: minimax-agent-router
description: Delegate only well-fitted, scoped chores to Claude Code CLI backed by MiniMax, with task-fit gating, five-minute worker budgets, bounded parallel batches, and mandatory Codex verification.

interface.shortDescription: Gate and route suitable small chores to Claude Code + MiniMax.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin that first assesses task fit, then delegates only low-risk research, documentation, tests, read-only review, and narrowly scoped mechanical implementation to Claude Code CLI through MiniMax. It enforces a five-minute default budget, structured scope and verification prompts, bounded parallel workers, progress events, and pending-Codex review status. Codex keeps ownership of architecture, unfamiliar APIs, platform integration, security, deployment, and final verification.
defaultPrompt: Use MiniMax for safe coding chores
Check whether this task is suitable for MiniMax
Run these independent chores in parallel
